activationConditions: Integration Smoke overallStatus is PASS on exact canonical 4782aa with runtimeExecuted=true and renderedParityEstablished=true.
Release/Package emits the reserved deterministic 4782aa source-tree checkpoint and Control Tower records it as current packaged canonical.
Live canonical still equals 4782aa, or a newer packaged descendant is explicitly reconciled before activation.
No other product producer is active and WIP cap remains at or below 2/3 before opening this producer.
PR227 classroom/free-roam contract and PR228 progression/mobile seam remain valid against the activation base.

authorityFreeze.rule: Remain the sole ephemeral class/session authority unless intentionally changed within Class & Education ownership while preserving one-authority semantics.
Remain the sole server adapter to Foundation schedule/room and ClassEducation remotes.
Durable progression remains separate; minigame score/grade presentation cannot directly write persistence.
No second progression repository or completion store.

boundedProductGoal: Use the authoritative current class room/session to enter one evidence-backed activity presentation.
Expose a distinct instruction/entry state before active play.
Run one bounded in-world activity with server-returned event feedback.
Present one authoritative Report Card-style completion summary after server completion.
Restore room/world free roam, compact HUD and movement/camera after acknowledged completion or valid leave.
Persist completion exactly once and preserve retry/rejoin semantics.
producerRules: Do not add another school clock, schedule, class/session, progression, reward, persistence, travel, spawn or economy authority.
Do not infer score, grade, reward, XP, timing, activity IDs, remote names or hidden UI hierarchy from sampled footage.
Observed activity score/grade fields remain ephemeral server-returned presentation unless a separately scoped durable-progression change is approved.
Do not treat the current generic text-question catalog as RHS2 activity parity.
Preserve P1 feature-panel/HUD responsive geometry and safe-area contracts.
Use stable action/completion identities so duplicate input and completion replay are deterministic and idempotent.
requiredDeterministicTests: duplicate activity action id cannot apply twice
leave and period/session end clear an incomplete activity without fabricating completion
failed durable commit shows pending state, blocks false Report Card success and blocks return to free roam
retry of the same completion identity commits exactly once
post-commit replay is duplicate and cannot re-award progression
client contract preserves one activity surface and restores compact HUD/input
desktop/iPhone/iPad geometry checks keep activity/result surfaces inside safe bounds and outside movement/camera zones
